title: The extra read removes the remaining outcome-dependent linear term
statement: For X~N(0, I), f=X^TAX+b^TX+c, define B(k)=2[sum_(j>k)lambda_j^2+sum_(j>k)mu_j^2] on positive/negative eigenvalue magnitudes, with convex piecewise-linear interpolation. Almost every adaptive transcript has residual N(0, Q) and risk2||QAQ||F^2+||Q(b+2Am)||^2; adaptive m is not unconditionally Gaussian. Classical Fan–Pall compression gives B(k) as a lower bound for EVERY hard/expected k-read comparator. Pair leading opposing eigendirections so first-batch compression D has2||D||F^2=B(k), then read along t=Q(b+2Am). The correct predictor retains trD+(w^TDw)(z^2-1); averaged quadratic cross terms give risk<=B(k). At most min(n, k+1) exact reads suffice; noninteger k uses independently randomized first-batch size and only EXPECTED count<=k+1. It is not optimal at its own budget: the retained two-read threshold policy for2U^TV has value4.716565402 versus simplepaired/fixed4. Semidefinite homogeneous targets have no same-budget exact adaptive advantage.

requires: Known real symmetric A, b, c and X~N(0, I), or an actually acquired whitening transform with its own costs. Exact predictable scalar linear functionals, independent policy seed and almost-sure return. Dense measurement access must physically be supplied.
For noisy fixed benchmark: independent standard Gaussian U, V, unit measurement rows and independent equal-variance Gaussian readout s; exact optimal-fixed theorem only0 < s <= 1, r <= 2m.

Same law and measurement-policy class for model transfer; actual supplied/earned L2 error, calibration and implementation certificates. Finite interpolation agreement does not identify a quadratic promise.

assumptions: Completed P1 original-source mathematical construction with actual acquired scoped internal audits in the distinct matching ZIP. The older denied archive was not retried. Arbitrary programmable scalar LINEAR measurements are a stronger access contract than the previous coordinate interface. Exact quadratic/known Gaussian and stated noise assumptions are substantive. k+1 versus k is an additive-budget comparison, not a same-budget optimizer. Hard exact-query classification does not classify expected exact counts; noisy optimal-fixed statement needs unit rows and0 < s <= 1. Root-MSE transfer has2tau outside square roots, not MSE+2tau. Dense controls, model/prior/noise acquisition, precision, source preparation and full ordinary alternatives remain paid. Jackowski1991 overlap is UNKNOWN; public403/no acquired body is neither novelty evidence nor an acceptance gate. No new science replay, audit/sign-off or practical/device advantage.
costs: Known dense matrix costsTheta(n^2) to read and O(n^3) eigensolve/O(n^2) storage; final direction costsO(nk) arithmetic plus programming/transmission of dense coefficients and actual physical linear measurement.

Promised quadratic stencil uses(n+1)(n+2)/2 source evaluations, each paid at source execution cost; dense input interface submits n times that many coordinates.32-dimensional fixture pays561 queries,17,952 coordinates and17 reads per deployment.

Exact balanced read-count saving tends to factor2, not unbounded speedup. Learning/calibration may dominate; ordinary full-input/live-evaluator and fully informed fixed sensing receive the same model and hardware.
